title: Digital acceptance, without a rule — a screen shows terms before a user action is recorded
titleEs: Aceptación digital — Microescena con objetos y actores
description: Two standing parties with pigeonhole racks. Party A hands its screen (●) to Party B; at the terms-shown station the screen's shade slides up and it shows generic placeholder term rows and a generic button, a scroll rail drawing past each row. Then Party B hands over its action device (◆, the same button pressed, at equal weight), which opens at Party A: action recorded, as supplied. Each event adds a station to the strip "Sequence as supplied (illustrative)". The hold shows the supplied status: informed action, or presentation to be examined (a dashed pending outline inside the indicated device — a supplied, pending question only). No rule on online acceptance and no legal effect is stated.

durationMs.description: Total length of the finite timeline in milliseconds. Phases scale proportionally; the final state is held.

seed.description: Seed for small deterministic variations (appearance defaults, hand-drawn jitter). Same seed + time + params = same frame.

locale.description: Language of built-in labels (en or es). User-supplied text is never translated.

theme.description: Render treatment. Only tested themes are listed.

palette.description: Colour palette applied to props, actors and accents.

background.description: transparent, paper, white, light-grey, charcoal or a #rrggbb colour.

safeArea.description: Caption-safe margins as fractions of the frame.

reducedMotion.description: Removes decorative motion (overshoot, idle sway, camera drift) while keeping instructional motion.

textVisibility.description: all labels, key labels only, or none (the action must remain readable without labels).

jurisdiction.description: Descriptive jurisdiction tag. "unspecified" means no legal system is asserted.

contentNotice.description: Shows a small "illustrative example" tag inside the safe area.

role.description: Descriptive role label (not a legal finding)

appearance.description: Optional appearance overrides; defaults derive from the seed

parties.description: Party A (presents the screen) and Party B (the user); fictional by default (array replaces the previous value)

reference.description: Reference shown on Party A's screen (fictional)

title.description: Heading of the screen, as supplied (generic, e.g. "Terms on screen (supplied text)")

value.description: Row text, as supplied (fictional placeholder); a value starting with "(" is printed after the name without a colon

items.description: Row shown on the device, as supplied (generic and fictional placeholder, e.g. "Term 1" + "(supplied text)"; never real terms)

terms.description: Placeholder term rows shown on the screen, as supplied (2–4; generic and fictional, never real terms) (array replaces the previous value)

reference.description: Reference shown on Party B's device (fictional)

text.description: Heading of Party B's action, as supplied

responses.description: Party B's action device (its reference and heading as supplied) (array replaces the previous value)

value.description: Row text, as supplied (fictional placeholder); a value starting with "(" is printed after the name without a colon

items.description: Row shown on the device, as supplied (generic and fictional placeholder, e.g. "Term 1" + "(supplied text)"; never real terms)

termsB.description: Rows of Party B's action as supplied (1–4; generic and fictional, e.g. the generic button) (array replaces the previous value)

time.description: Fictional time label as supplied, e.g. "Day 3, 10:00 (fictional)" (for the terms-shown station: the supplied status of the presentation, e.g. "Presentation to be examined (as supplied)")

position.description: Optional position in the supplied order (1 = first). Events given the same position are shown together, order to be examined

items.description: One event of the supplied sequence. The order of the list is the order shown; events with the same position are shown together as an order to be examined. Times are fictional labels, never computed or compared

sequence.description: The screen's and the action's journeys and the terms shown, as supplied, in the order shown (1–5). The order is depicted, never resolved (array replaces the previous value)

a.description: Caption for Party A (hands over the screen ●)

b.description: Caption for Party B (hands over the action device ◆)

actorLabels.description: Role captions shown under each party

actionProgress.description: How far the concrete action is allowed to progress (1 = complete; lower values freeze it part-way)

target.description: Scene element the annotation points at

items.description: Editorial annotation shown during the hold

annotations.description: Editorial callouts shown in the final hold (array replaces the previous value)

finalState.description: Status supplied for the hold: action-recorded (a tag "Informed action, as supplied"), presentation-to-examine (a tag "Presentation to be examined, as supplied"; a dashed pending outline inside the indicated device's border — a supplied, pending question only) or sequence-to-examine. No legal effect is inferred from any of them

pendingParty.description: Whose device carries the pending outline when the status is presentation to be examined
